_meta.purpose: License-verified public/open psychological assessment instruments for a self-hosted Chinese-language website. All scoring is client-side; no server-side data sale.
_meta.safety_note: Screening instruments are NOT diagnostic. Every result page must carry a crisis-resources notice. PHQ-9 item 9 (self-harm) requires an immediate escalation path.
_meta.verification_policy: Fields marked UNVERIFIED could not be confirmed from a primary source in this pass. Do not ship unverified license claims.
_meta.language_note: Chinese strings below are the officially published translations where a primary source was located. Where no official Chinese translation exists, the field is null and a translation must be produced by a qualified translator with back-translation.

instruments.zh_name: 病人健康问卷抑郁量表 / 患者健康问卷-9（PHQ-9）
instruments.scoring: Sum all 9 items, 0-27. Additionally a functional-impairment item (not scored).
instruments.cutoffs: 5 / 10 / 15 / 20 thresholds. >=10 is the conventional screening cut-point (sensitivity ~88%, specificity ~88%).

items_en: Little interest or pleasure in doing things
Feeling down, depressed, or hopeless
Trouble falling or staying asleep, or sleeping too much
Feeling tired or having little energy
Poor appetite or overeating
Feeling bad about yourself - or that you are a failure or have let yourself or your family down
Trouble concentrating on things, such as reading the newspaper or watching television
Moving or speaking so slowly that other people could have noticed. Or the opposite - being so fidgety or restless that you have been moving around a lot more than usual
Thoughts that you would be better off dead, or of hurting yourself in some way

instruments.reverse_note: Items 2, 5, 6, 8, 9 are negatively worded. With the 0-3 coding above, reverse them (0<->3, 1<->2) before summing. The original 1-4 administration reverses to 4/3/2/1. Sum range 0-30 (or 10-40).
instruments.scoring: Sum 10 items after reversing the 5 negative items. Range 0-30.
instruments.interpretation: Below 15 suggests low self-esteem; 15-25 within normal range; higher is better.

instruments.prompt_zh: 以下是一些关于你对自己总体感受的陈述。请指出你对每项陈述的同意程度。
items_en: On the whole, I am satisfied with myself.
At times I think I am no good at all.
I feel that I have a number of good qualities.
I am able to do things as well as most other people.
I feel I do not have much to be proud of.
I certainly feel useless at times.
I feel that I'm a person of worth, at least on an equal plane with others.
I wish I could have more respect for myself.
All in all, I am inclined to feel that I am a failure.
I take a positive attitude toward myself.
items_zh: 总体而言，我对自己是满意的。

我希望能更多地尊重自己。
总的来说，我倾向于觉得自己是个失败者。
我对自己持肯定的态度。

instruments.en_name: Three-Item Loneliness Scale (UCLA Loneliness Scale short form)
instruments.zh_name: UCLA 孤独量表简版（3条目）
instruments.scoring: Sum the 3 items, range 3-9. Higher = lonelier.
instruments.cutoffs: There is NO accepted cut-off for classifying a person as 'lonely' (stated verbatim by the UK GSS harmonised standard). Report mean scores, or report the proportion selecting 'often' on each item. Hughes et al. (2004) reported a cut-point of 6 in some analyses, but treat banding as advisory only.

license.name: Free to use; the 3-item set is an ONS/GSS harmonised standard derived from the UCLA Loneliness Scale (Russell 1996)
license.verbatim: UNVERIFIED - no primary rights-holder licence statement located; the parent UCLA Loneliness Scale is copyrighted by its author but the 3-item short set is adopted as an official UK government statistical standard and is reproduced verbatim by government and open-access sources.
license.note: Safest evidence of public availability: the UK Government Analysis Function publishes the exact item wording and response options as the GSS harmonised standard for loneliness, and the US NSHAP study publishes the same 3 items. Attribute Hughes et al. (2004) and, if useful, note the GSS harmonised standard.
license.wording_variants: Hughes et al. 2004 / NSHAP use response options 'Hardly ever / Some of the time / Often'. The UK GSS harmonised standard uses 'Hardly ever or never / Some of the time / Often'. These are NOT directly comparable - pick one and state which.

instruments.citation: Hughes, M. E., Waite, L. J., Hawkley, L. C., & Cacioppo, J. T. (2004). A short scale for measuring loneliness in large surveys. Research on Aging, 26(6), 655-672.

instruments.zh_name: WHO-5 幸福感指数（世界卫生组织五项身心健康指标）
instruments.recall: 过去两周 (over the last two weeks)

labels_en: Less than half of the time
More than half of the time

instruments.scoring: Sum the 5 raw items, range 0-25. Multiply by 4 to obtain a percentage score 0-100 (where 0 = worst imaginable well-being, 100 = best imaginable).
instruments.cutoffs: A percentage score < 50 suggests poor well-being and warrants further testing. A score <= 28 or <= 32 (varying guidance) suggests likely depression. Also used as a continuous outcome measure.

instruments.zh_name: 开放式扩展荣格类型量表（OEJTS，16型人格）
instruments.items_note: 32 core scored items + 28 experimental/Likert items in the current published version. Some older mirrors distribute only the 32 bipolar items. The 48-item pool was reduced to 12 items per dichotomy during development.
instruments.reverse_scored: Bipolar format: the left/right anchors already encode direction; no separate reverse keying. Score each dichotomy as the sum of item scores after orienting each item to a fixed pole.
instruments.scoring: Four continuous dichotomy scores (I/E, S/N, T/F, J/P). Each is dichotomised at the midpoint to produce a 16-type code (e.g. INFJ). The continuous scores should also be shown as a preference strength percentage.

instruments.en_name: Experiences in Close Relationships - Relationship Structures (ECR-RS)
instruments.zh_name: 亲密关系经历量表-关系结构版（ECR-RS，9条目依恋量表）
instruments.items_note: The SAME 9 items are administered for each relationship target (global/general, mother, father, romantic partner, best friend). A 9-item single-target administration is a valid standalone short attachment measure.

response_scale.modern_variant: The author notes the lab has since gravitated to a simpler 5-point scale; the 2011 publication used 1-7. Pick one and stay consistent.

instruments.reverse_note: Avoidance = mean of items 1-6 with items 1, 2, 3, 4 reverse-keyed. Anxiety = mean of items 7-9 (no reversal).
instruments.scoring: Two scores per target: avoidance (items 1-6, reverse-key 1-4) and anxiety (items 7-9), each a mean. Global scores = mean across relationship domains, or use the separate 'close relationships in general' 9-item administration. Cross the two dimensions (high/low) to obtain four attachment styles, or report both dimensions continuously (recommended).

items_en: It helps to turn to this person in times of need.

I talk things over with this person.
I find it easy to depend on this person.
I don't feel comfortable opening up to this person.
I prefer not to show this person how I feel deep down.
I often worry that this person doesn't really care for me.
I'm afraid that this person may abandon me.
I worry that this person won't care about me as much as I care about him or her.

I'm afraid that other people may abandon me.
I worry that others won't care about me as much as I care about them.
instruments.recommendation: PREFER THIS OVER THE ECR-S for adult attachment. Same construct, far better provenance (author publishes everything openly and invites translation), and it works for multiple relationship targets which is a nice UX feature.

instruments.zh_name: 知觉压力量表（PSS-10）
instruments.recall: 过去一个月 (in the last month)
instruments.reverse_note: Items 4, 5, 7, 8 are the positively stated items and must be reversed (0<->4, 1<->3).
instruments.scoring: Reverse items 4, 5, 7, 8 then sum all 10. Range 0-40.
instruments.cutoffs: There are NO diagnostic cut-offs. PSS is not a diagnostic instrument. Interpretation uses within-sample comparison against published normative means/SDs (e.g. Cohen & Janicki-Deverts 2012 US probability samples; 1983 US sample mean ~13.0 for PSS-10).
instruments.subscales: Often reported as 2 factors (helplessness: 1,2,3,6,9,10; self-efficacy: 4,5,7,8), but the recommended use is a single total score.

license.name: Copyrighted - permission REQUIRED via MAPI Research Trust / ePROVIDE
license.verbatim: Please submit permission requests to use the Perceived Stress Scale (PSS) through the ePROVIDE platform of MAPI RESEARCH TRUST
license.commercial_use: Requires a licence; commercial use is not free.
license.cost: Submitting a permission request is completely free of charge, but it is a formal request process and not an open licence.
license.redistribution: Not an open licence - do not treat as public domain.
license.item_text_public: The item text is published openly on the Carnegie Mellon lab page, but publication of the items is not the same as an open licence to redistribute.
license.translations: Non-English translations are the sole intellectual property of the translator; permission requests go to the translator, not Dr. Cohen.

sources.chinese_validation_open_access: https://journals.plos.org/plosone/article?id=10.1371/journal.pone.0028610 (Wang et al. 2011, PLoS ONE, CC BY - Chinese PSS-10 in policewomen)

instruments.citation: Cohen, S., Kamarck, T., & Mermelstein, R. (1983). A global measure of perceived stress. Journal of Health and Social Behavior, 24, 385-396.
items_en: In the last month, how often have you been upset because of something that happened unexpectedly?
In the last month, how often have you felt that you were unable to control the important things in your life?
In the last month, how often have you felt nervous and "stressed"?
In the last month, how often have you felt confident about your ability to handle your personal problems?
In the last month, how often have you felt that things were going your way?
In the last month, how often have you found that you could not cope with all the things that you had to do?
In the last month, how often have you been able to control irritations in your life?
In the last month, how often have you felt that you were on top of things?
In the last month, how often have you been angered because of things that were outside of your control?
In the last month, how often have you felt difficulties were piling up so high that you could not overcome them?
instruments.recommendation: REPLACE with a fully open alternative where possible. Good substitutes: (a) the 10-item Perceived Stress Reactivity / (b) the freely licensed DASS-21 stress subscale (7 items, public domain), or (c) submit the free ePROVIDE permission request and keep PSS-10.

instruments.en_name: Experiences in Close Relationships Scale - Short Form (ECR-S)
instruments.zh_name: 亲密关系经历量表简版（ECR-S，依恋焦虑/回避）
instruments.reverse_scored: See the published article for the reverse-keyed items; UNVERIFIED in this pass.
instruments.scoring: Two 6-item subscale means, each range 1-7. Higher = more attachment anxiety / more avoidance. There is no total score; the two dimensions are crossed to give four attachment styles.

license.name: UNVERIFIED - likely free for research use
license.verbatim: UNVERIFIED - no primary licence statement located in this pass
license.item_text_public: The 12 items are published in Wei et al. (2007) and are reproduced in open-access papers.

sources.parent_ecr_36_item: Brennan, K. A., Clark, C. L., & Shaver, P. R. (1998). Self-report measurement of adult attachment. In Attachment theory and close relationships (pp. 46-76).

instruments.citation: Wei, M., Russell, D. W., Mallinckrodt, B., & Vogel, D. L. (2007). The Experiences in Close Relationships Scale (ECR)-Short Form. Journal of Counseling Psychology, 54(2), 187-198.
instruments.recommendation: LOWER CONFIDENCE than the other instruments. The 12-item ECR-S has no explicit open licence. Prefer shipping a clearly-licensed alternative or obtain written permission from the authors. The items are short enough that asking the corresponding author for permission is realistic.

instruments.zh_name: Zung 抑郁自评量表（SDS）
instruments.reverse_note: 10 positively worded items are reverse-scored to form the 20-item total. Verified against the NovoPsych Zung SDS form's scoring block, which pre-reverses exactly items 2, 5, 6, 11, 12, 14, 16, 17, 18, 20. Note: this reverse key is part of the copyrighted scoring apparatus - do not rely on it if you do not clear the item rights.
instruments.scoring: Raw sum 20-80. SDS Index = (raw total / 80) x 100, giving 25-100.
instruments.cutoffs: SDS Index: <50 normal; 50-59 mild depression; 60-69 moderate; >=70 severe. (Published Zung bands.)
instruments.subscales: Zung describes 4 clusters: pervasive affect, physiological, psychomotor, psychological. Items are not usually scored as subscales.

license.name: RESTRICTED / UNVERIFIED - copyright asserted, commercial vendors treat it as licensed
license.verbatim: Availability: Costs associated or copyright restricted, contact us for more information. (Medical-Objects Explorer Online clinical form catalogue, Zung SDS entry)
license.commercial_use: UNVERIFIED - frequently treated as requiring permission
license.redistribution: Do NOT assume free redistribution. Widely reproduced in textbooks and academic papers, but no rights-holder open licence was located.
license.item_text_public: Items are widely republished in academic literature, but that is not an open licence.

sources.original: Zung, W. W. (1965). A self-rating depression scale. Archives of General Psychiatry, 12(1), 63-70.

instruments.recommendation: AVOID unless you obtain written permission or verify public-domain status. Use PHQ-9 (fully open) as the depression screener instead. Zung SAS has the same problem.

instruments.zh_name: Zung 焦虑自评量表（SAS）
instruments.reverse_scored: 5 items are reverse-scored (the positively worded ones). UNVERIFIED exact numbers - verify against the official scoring sheet.
instruments.scoring: Raw sum 20-80. SAS Index = (raw total / 80) x 100.
instruments.cutoffs: SAS Index >=50 indicates clinically significant anxiety; 50-59 mild, 60-69 moderate, >=70 severe. Chinese norms commonly use 50 as the threshold.

license.name: RESTRICTED / UNVERIFIED - same status as Zung SDS
license.item_text_public: Widely republished academically but no open licence located.

sources.original: Zung, W. W. (1971). A rating instrument for anxiety disorders. Psychosomatics, 12(6), 371-379.

instruments.recommendation: AVOID. Use GAD-7 (fully open) as the anxiety screener instead.

instruments.zh_name: 大五人格简版量表（BFI-10）
instruments.stem_en: I see myself as someone who...
instruments.stem_zh: 我认为自己是一个……的人
instruments.reverse_note: CORRECTED. Reverse-keyed items are 1, 3, 4, 5, 7. Forward-keyed (no reversal): 2, 6, 8, 9, 10. Verified verbatim against two independent sources that agree exactly: the University at Buffalo Social Work PDF transcription of the Berkeley BFI-10, and the REDCap instrument CSV in the Apache-2.0 repo ghoshted/BFI-10.
instruments.scoring: Mean of the two items per pair after reversing: Extraversion = mean(1R, 6) · Agreeableness = mean(2, 7R) · Conscientiousness = mean(3R, 8) · Neuroticism = mean(4R, 9) · Openness = mean(5R, 10). Each dimension 1-5. No total score.
instruments.prompt_en: How well do the following statements describe your personality?
items_en: ... is reserved
... is generally trusting
... tends to be lazy
... is relaxed, handles stress well
... has few artistic interests
... is outgoing, sociable
... tends to find fault with others
... does a thorough job
... gets nervous easily
... has an active imagination
instruments.items_note: Presented under the stem 'I see myself as someone who ...'. Stems above are the completion clauses as printed in the Berkeley BFI-10 form.
items_zh: ……是内向、拘谨的。（反向计分）
……一般比较信任他人。
……往往比较懒散。（反向计分）
……是放松的、能很好地应对压力。（反向计分）
……对艺术兴趣不大。（反向计分）
……外向、善于社交。
……往往爱挑别人的毛病。（反向计分）
……做事 thorough／踏实彻底。
……容易紧张。
……想象力丰富。
instruments.items_zh_note: The zh strings above are a working translation - no official Chinese BFI-10 was located. Have it reviewed by a bilingual psychologist before shipping. Note item 8: 做事 thorough should be rendered 做事踏实彻底 or 做事 thorough 有始有终; use a reviewed wording.

license.name: UNRESOLVED - do NOT treat as cleared
license.verbatim: no verbatim licence sentence located; none appears to be published
license.item_text_public: The stems are published in Rammstedt & John (2007) and in open-access replications, and a permissively-licensed repo (ghoshted/BFI-10, Apache-2.0) redistributes them - but that is repository-level licensing of a transcription, not a grant from the authors.
license.critical: The BFI-10 stems are near-verbatim BFI-44 items owned by the Berkeley / Oliver P. John lab. There is NO authoritative statement that the BFI-10 item text is public domain or freely reproducible. Treat as UNRESOLVED.
license.repo_license_caveat: An MIT/Apache repo licence covers that repo's code, not the copyright of the underlying instrument items. Do not infer instrument rights from a repo's LICENSE file.

sources.original: Rammstedt, B., & John, O. P. (2007). Measuring personality in one minute or less. Journal of Research in Personality, 41(1), 203-212.

instruments.recommendation: The mini-IPIP is STRICTLY BETTER LICENSED (true public domain, commercial use allowed). Prefer mini-IPIP over BFI-10 unless you specifically need BFI comparability.

instruments.en_name: Adult ADHD Self-Report Scale v1.1 - 6-Question Screener (ASRS v1.1)
instruments.zh_name: 成人ADHD自评量表（ASRS v1.1，6题筛查版）
instruments.items_note: The 6-item screener is a subset of the 18-question ASRS v1.1 Symptom Checklist. Items 1-3 of the screener are drawn from the inattentive set and items 4-6 from the hyperactive/impulsive set.
instruments.recall: 过去6个月 (over the past 6 months)
instruments.scoring: Each item is scored 0-4. Items 1, 2, 3 are counted as positive if the response is Sometimes/Often/Very Often (>=2). Items 4, 5, 6 are counted as positive only if Often/Very Often (>=3). 4 or more positive items out of 6 = symptoms highly consistent with ADHD; further evaluation recommended. The screener yields a screening result only, never a diagnosis.

license.name: Free for clinical and non-clinical use INCLUDING commercial use, with attribution; no modification other than creating electronic versions
license.verbatim: The screener is freely available for clinical and non-clinical use, including commercial use, but does require attribution. This is an evidence-based tool, and as such no other modifications, other than creating electronic versions, are permitted.
license.modification: Only conversion to an electronic version is permitted. Do NOT re-translate or reword - use the official WHO/NYU/Harvard translations.
license.attribution_line: The 6-question Adult Self-Report Scale-Version1.1 (ASRS-V1.1) Screener is a subset of the 18-question Adult ADHD Self-Report Scale-Version1.1 (Adult ASRS-V1.1) Symptom Checklist. (c) New York University and the President and Fellows of Harvard College.

instruments.citation: Adler, L. A., & Kessler, R. C. (creators). ASRS v1.1 Screener. (c) New York University and the President and Fellows of Harvard College.
instruments.recommendation: STRONGLY RECOMMENDED for ADHD coverage - explicit permission including commercial use, and official Simplified + Traditional Chinese translations already exist. Use the official Chinese PDFs verbatim; do not re-translate.

instruments.zh_name: Connor-Davidson 心理弹性量表
instruments.scoring: Sum items, higher = more resilience. Not needed - do not ship.

license.name: RESTRICTED - explicit licence agreement that FORBIDS publishing the items
verbatim: You agree (i) not to use the CD-RISC for any commercial purpose unless permission has been granted, or (ii) in research or other non-commercial activities...
In any publication or report resulting from use of the CD-RISC, you do not publish or partially reproduce items from the CD-RISC.
license.critical: The licence explicitly prohibits publishing or partially reproducing the items. Embedding them in a public website is a licence breach even for a free non-commercial site.

sources.terms_evidence: Verbatim licence clauses reproduced in university theses, e.g. https://repositorio.usil.edu.pe/bitstreams/23765133-1fe3-484e-9e09-04d789a0c552/download and https://oak.ulsan.ac.kr/bitstream/2021.oak/6796/2/200000182264.pdf

instruments.citation: Connor, K. M., & Davidson, J. R. T. (2003). Development of a new resilience scale: The Connor-Davidson Resilience Scale (CD-RISC). Depression and Anxiety, 18(2), 76-82.
instruments.safe_alternative: Brief Resilience Scale (Smith, B. W., et al. 2008, International Journal of Behavioral Medicine 15(3), 194-200) - published open-access, 6 items, free for research use.

instruments.en_name: PHQ-9 item 9 crisis protocol (implementation note, not a scale)
instruments.zh_name: PHQ-9 第9题危机处理流程（实现说明）

license.name: n/a - implementation guidance

instruments.rule: If PHQ-9 item 9 (thoughts of being better off dead / hurting yourself) is scored > 0, immediately show a crisis-intervention interstitial with hotline numbers before showing any score. Do not wait for the total score page.
instruments.note: This is a safety requirement, not a legal one. Screeners that surface suicidal ideation without an escalation path are a duty-of-care failure.

instruments.zh_name: 罗森伯格自尊量表中文版
instruments.license: Same as RSES - public domain asserted
instruments.note: Chinese wording given under rses.items_zh above. No single official Chinese translation exists; the version above is a faithful rendering - have it reviewed by a bilingual psychologist before shipping.

avoid_restricted.zh_name: MBTI 迈尔斯-布里格斯类型指标
avoid_restricted.reason: Registered trademark 'MBTI', 'Myers-Briggs' and the four-letter type codes; all items are copyrighted and commercially licensed. Administering a look-alike test under MBTI branding is trademark infringement.
avoid_restricted.safe_alternative: OEJTS 1.2 (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0) - but must not be called MBTI and must carry attribution + share-alike.

avoid_restricted.zh_name: 明尼苏达多相人格调查表
avoid_restricted.reason: All rights reserved. Strictly licensed per-administration, with a per-use fee. Reproduction of any item is prohibited.
avoid_restricted.safe_alternative: None equivalent. Do not attempt a look-alike clinical inventory.

avoid_restricted.reason: Copyrighted and sold by Pearson. The Chinese SCL-90 is extremely widely used in China, but wide use does not make it licensed. Reproducing the items is a rights violation.
avoid_restricted.safe_alternative: For multi-domain symptom coverage use PHQ-9 + GAD-7 + DASS-21 (all open) or the public-domain IPIP instruments.

avoid_restricted.zh_name: 卡特尔16种人格因素问卷
avoid_restricted.reason: Copyrighted commercial instrument. Items are not published openly.
avoid_restricted.safe_alternative: IPIP-NEO-120 or mini-IPIP (public domain) for broad personality coverage.

avoid_restricted.reason: Not public domain. Distributed under an explicit licence with fees for some uses and a permission requirement. Do not assume non-commercial use is free.
avoid_restricted.safe_alternative: The Brief Resilience Scale (Smith et al. 2008) is published in an open-access journal and is free for research use, or use the IPIP public-domain pool.

avoid_restricted.holder: Sheldon Cohen / Carnegie Mellon; licensing via MAPI Research Trust ePROVIDE
avoid_restricted.reason: Not an open licence. A free permission request is required and commercial use is not granted automatically. Items are published openly but the licence is not open.
avoid_restricted.safe_alternative: DASS-21 stress subscale (7 items, public domain) or the freely published PSS-10 Chinese validation if you separately clear rights.

avoid_restricted.zh_name: Zung 抑郁/焦虑自评量表（需核实授权）
avoid_restricted.holder: Zung / Duke University lineage; commercial clinical form vendors treat it as copyright restricted
avoid_restricted.reason: No open licence located; at least one clinical software catalogue lists it as 'Costs associated or copyright restricted'. Widely reproduced in academic papers, which does not create a redistribution licence.
avoid_restricted.safe_alternative: PHQ-9 for depression and GAD-7 for anxiety - both explicitly free to reproduce, translate, display and distribute.

avoid_restricted.en_name: Beck Depression Inventory / Beck Anxiety Inventory (BDI-II, BAI)
avoid_restricted.zh_name: 贝克抑郁量表／贝克焦虑量表
avoid_restricted.reason: Copyrighted and commercially licensed. Items are not openly published.

avoid_restricted.zh_name: 亲密关系经历量表简版（需核实）
avoid_restricted.reason: No explicit open licence located in this pass. Not a 'restricted for sure' case - but it is not a 'verified open' case either.
avoid_restricted.safe_alternative: Request written permission from the corresponding author, or use a clearly-licensed alternative.

avoid_restricted.reason: No explicit open licence; frequently granted free for research on request. Items are printed in the Berkeley lab's public web page and in papers.
avoid_restricted.safe_alternative: mini-IPIP or IPIP-NEO-120 - genuinely public domain including commercial use. Strictly better.

recommended_minimum_shippable_set.rationale: Highest legal certainty + best Chinese availability + good coverage. All of these can ship today with attribution.
mandatory_disclaimers: 自评量表仅供筛查与自我了解，不能作为诊断依据。
如有自伤或危机念头，请立即联系当地心理援助热线（中国大陆：24小时心理援助热线 12356；北京 010-82951332；生命教育与危机干预热线 400-161-9995）。
PHQ-9 第9题如为阳性（>0），必须立即触发危机提示页面。
